title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Biosafety Cabinets
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which class of Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) protects the product, the personnel, and the environment?
questions.explain: Class II BSCs use HEPA filtered airflow to protect the user (inflow), the product (downflow), and the environment (exhaust). Class I protects only the user/environment. Laminar flow hoods protect only the product. Fume hoods protect only the user from chemicals, not biologicals.
